headline: Approved orders of conditions for Brook Street Culvert, 397 Transmission Line project, and 30 Argilla Road with $22,700 bond.
summary: The Methuen Conservation Commission issued Orders of Conditions for three projects: the Brook Street Culvert work by TEC, Inc. for the Methuen Department of Public Works, the 397 Transmission Line Asset Condition Refurbishment Project by BSC Group, and a project at 30 Argilla Road by Nina Piro, which includes a $22,700 performance bond. A motion on a Request for Determination of Applicability for 38 Atkinson Street was made and seconded, but the minutes do not record a vote result.
decisions: Issued Order of Conditions with Special Conditions 1-50 for the Brook Street Culvert project (DEP File #219-1324, MCC File #26-005).
Issued Order of Conditions with Special Conditions 1-48 for the 397 Transmission Line Asset Condition Refurbishment Project (DEP File #219-1321, MCC File #26-002).
Issued Order of Conditions with Special Conditions 1-48 and a $22,700 Performance Bond for 30 Argilla Road (DEP File #219-1325, MCC File #26-006).

plain_text:
CITY OF METHUEN 
CONSERVATION COMMISSION 
Minutes of a Special Public Meeting – September 10, 2026 
The City of Methuen Conservation Commission held a special public meeting on September 10, 
2026, at 7:00 p.m.  The meeting was scheduled to take place at the Searles Building, 41 Pleasant 
Street, Second Floor Conference Room, and via Zoom.  
1. CALL TO ORDER: 
The participants started the meeting at 7:00 p.m. 
• Dave Di Zazzo (Chair) 
• Kenneth Sateriale (Secretary)  
• Rachel Lecher (Commissioner) 
• Sandra Boulay (Commissioner) 
• Chris Parsons (Conservation Officer) 
• Michelle Davidson (Conservation Clerk) 
2. ACCEPTANCE OF AGENDA / AMENDMENTS: 
An amendment to the agenda was considered to specify that verbiage would be added to Item 
3.B to read “Order of Conditions with Special Conditions 1-50.”  
MOTION: Motion made by Kenneth Sateriale to accept the agenda as amended.  Seconded by 
Sandra Boulay.  All in favor.  Vote: Unanimous.   
 
3. OLD BUSINESS: 
A. Order of Conditions with Special Conditions 1-49 DEP File #219-1324, MCC File #26-
005 – Brook Street Culvert – TEC, Inc. – Department of Public Works, Methuen, Massachusetts 
– Public hearing closed September 3, 2026. 
MOTION: Motion made by Kenneth Sateriale to issue Order of Conditions with Special 
Conditions 1-50.  Seconded by Rachel Lecher.  All in favor.  Vote: Unanimous.
Page 2 
B. Order of Conditions with Special Conditions 1-50 DEP File #219-1321, MCC File #26-002 – 
397 Transmission Line Asset Condition Refurbishment Project – BSC Group – Public hearing 
closed September 3, 2026. 
MOTION: Motion made by Kenneth Sateriale to issue Order of Conditions with Special 
Conditions 1-48.  Seconded by Rachel Lecher.  All in favor.  Vote: Unanimous.   
 
C. Order of Conditions with Special Conditions 1-48 and $22,700 Performance Bond 
DEP File #219-1325, MCC File #26-006 – 30 Argilla Road – Nina Piro – Public hearing closed 
September 3, 2026. 
MOTION: Motion made by Kenneth Sateriale to issue Order of Conditions with Special 
Conditions 1-48.  Seconded by Rachel Lecher.  All in favor.  Vote: Unanimous.   
 
D. Request for Determination of Applicability with Special Conditions 1-8 
#26-007 – 38 Atkinson Street – Greg Carlson Continued from September 3, 2026. 
MOTION: Motion made by Kenneth Sateriale to issue a Request for Determination of 
Applicability with a Negative Determination 2(b) under the state and a Negative Determination 5 
under the local, subject to Special Conditions 1–8. Seconded by Rachel Lecher.   
 
4. ADJOURNMENT: 7:09 
Respectfully submitted by, 
Dave Di Zazzo
